Coram : S. RAJENDRA BABU*, G.P. MATHUR
B Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 : S. 20(c) and Order VII, r. 10--Suit-Jurisdiction of Court-Agreement containing exclusionary clause-Part of cause of action arising at two places- C Held, having regard to the facts of the case, there was a clear intention to confine the jurisdiction of the courts In a suit for recovery of dues under a purchase order filed in the D court of District Judge, Delhi, the defendant-appellant moved an application under s. 20 r/w Order VII Rule 10 and s.151 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 for return of the plaint for proper presentation before the court
Decision Date : 16-04-2004 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2490/2004 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
